parole.significato: lychee (that tree's bright red oval fruit with a single stone surrounded by a fleshy white aril)
parole.testo: Internationalism. Ultimately from Chinese 荔枝 (lìzhī).
From שְׁטִיפַת־ (sh'tifát-, “washing of”) + מוח / מֹחַ (móakh, “brain”); calque of Chinese 洗腦 /洗脑 (xǐnǎo) via English brain-washing.
